evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and modifies cryptographic primitives and helpers in src/crypto/ and src/musig.cpp.
rationale: Cleanses sensitive cryptographic state on destruction to prevent leaking private keys and seed bytes in memory. CHMAC_SHA256 and CHMAC_SHA512 previously retained inner/outer hasher state from sensitive operations like SetSeed() and hardened BIP32 derivation, and CreateMuSig2PartialSig() left a stack keypair unzeroed.
